test_cases_present: partial - the AHCI 1.3.1 specification defines normative register behavior, FIS handling, state machine arcs (HBA + per-port), and software programming rules that map directly to compliance test scenarios; SATA-IO maintains a separate AHCI Interoperability Compliance Suite and the Serial ATA Interoperability Program test plan, which are out of scope of this register-level specification document.
derived_compliance_test_categories: HBA Reset — software writes GHC.HR=1; verify all RW1 / state machine arcs return to H:Init values; verify GHC.HR self-clears on reset complete.
AHCI Enable — write GHC.AE=1 when CAP.SAM=0; verify register memory space becomes accessible; verify CAP.SAM=1 forces GHC.AE RO=1.
PI register read — verify only implemented ports return 1 in PI; verify popcount(PI) ≤ CAP.NP+1.
VS register — verify 1.3.1 HBA returns 0x00010301.
Software Initialization of HBA — CAP read → PI read → for each implemented port: program PxCLB / PxCLBU + PxFB / PxFBU → set PxCMD.FRE=1 → set PxCMD.ST=1 → verify PxCMD.CR=1.
Port reset (PxSCTL.DET=1 → 0) — verify PHY runs COMRESET; verify device returns COMINIT; verify PxSSTS.DET transitions 00→01→03; verify device sends D2H Register FIS with signature into PxSIG.
Device signature — verify PxSIG = 0x00000101 for SATA disk, 0xEB140101 for ATAPI, 0xC33C0101 for Port Multiplier, 0x96690101 for Enclosure Mgmt.
Speed negotiation — set PxSCTL.SPD to cap at Gen 1/2/3; verify PxSSTS.SPD reflects the negotiated speed.

Single non-NCQ DMA command — software builds CFIS (FIS Type 0x27) + PRDT in system memory; sets PxCI[slot]; HBA fetches + transmits; device sends DMA Setup + Data + D2H Register FIS; verify PxIS.DHRS set; verify PxCI[slot] clears.

Single NCQ command (READ FPDMA QUEUED 0x60 / WRITE FPDMA QUEUED 0x61) — software sets PxSACT[slot] and PxCI[slot]; verify HBA auto-handles DMA Setup; verify Set Device Bits FIS clears PxSACT[slot]; verify PxIS.SDBS set.
Multiple NCQ commands — issue N (≤ 32) simultaneously; verify ordering and completion bits.
PIO transfer — IDENTIFY DEVICE 0xEC; verify PIO Setup FIS arrives in PSFIS; verify Data FIS arrives; verify D2H Register FIS finalizes.
ATAPI command — set PxCMD.ATAPI=1; build CFIS + ACMD; verify A bit handling.
FIS-based Switching — enable PxFBS.EN=1; address multiple Port Multiplier ports via DEV[11:8]; verify per-PMP context tracking.
Software Reset (SRST sequence) — build Command Header R=1 + CFIS with SRST=1; clear PxCI; build second CFIS with SRST=0; verify PxSIG updates and PxTFD.STS.BSY clears.
Hot plug — connect / disconnect device; verify PxSSTS.DET transitions; verify PxSERR.DIAG.X set; verify PxIS.PCS set; verify CAP.SMPS-gated PxIS.DMPS set if PxCMD.MPSP=1.
Cold Presence Detect — verify PxIS.CPDS sets when PxCMD.CPD=1 and presence changes.
Power Management — write PxCMD.ICC=2h (Partial); verify PxSSTS.IPM=2h; write PxCMD.ICC=6h (Slumber); verify PxSSTS.IPM=6h; write PxCMD.ICC=1h (Active); verify PxSSTS.IPM=1h.

Device Sleep — set CAP2.SDS=1 (PHY supports); write PxCMD.ICC=8h; verify HBA asserts DEVSLP sideband; verify PxSSTS.IPM=8h; write PxCMD.ICC=1h; verify DEVSLP de-asserts; verify Phy re-establishes within PxDEVSLP.DETO.
Aggressive Link Power Management — set CAP.SALP=1 + PxCMD.ALPE + PxCMD.ASP; verify HBA auto-enters Partial/Slumber after PxCI=0 + PxSACT=0.
Aggressive Device Sleep Management — set CAP2.SADM + PxDEVSLP.ADSE + PxDEVSLP.DITO; verify DEVSLP asserts after DITO timeout idle.
Command Completion Coalescing — set CAP.CCCS, configure CCC_CTL.TV / CCC_CTL.CC / CCC_PORTS, enable CCC_CTL.EN; verify CCC interrupt at IS.IPS[CCC_CTL.INT] aggregates completions.
Enclosure Management — set CAP.EMS; write a message into EM buffer; set EM_CTL.CTL.TM=1; verify message transmitted; verify EM_CTL.STS.MR=1 on receive.
BIOS/OS Handoff — verify BOHC.BOS / OOS / OOC semantics; OS reads BOS=1 → sets OOS=1 → BIOS clears BOS=0 → OS proceeds.
Native interrupt path — verify per-port PxIS bits OR'd into PxIE-gated IS.IPS[port]; verify GHC.IE=0 masks all interrupts.
MSI / MSI-X interrupt path — verify MSICAP.MSIE + Multiple Message Enable; verify single-MSI fallback (MRSM bit).
Task File Error — induce CRC error on D2H Register FIS; verify PxTFD.ERR updates; verify PxIS.TFES set.
Unknown FIS — inject FIS Type not in {0x27,0x34,0x39,0x41,0x46,0x58,0x5F,0xA1}; verify HBA copies to UFIS area; verify PxSERR.DIAG.F + PxIS.UFS.
PRD Overflow — device sends more data than total PRDT byte count; verify PxIS.OFS set.
Incorrect Port Multiplier — receive FIS from a PMP value with no outstanding command; verify PxIS.IPMS set.
Interface Fatal Error — induce repeated CRC errors; verify PxIS.IFS + matching PxSERR bits; verify port stops.
Interface Non-fatal Error — induce single CRC error recovered; verify PxIS.INFS only.
Asynchronous Notification — device sends Set Device Bits FIS with N bit on a Port Multiplier; verify PxSNTF bit set for that PMP.
Staggered Spin-up — set CAP.SSS=1; verify PxCMD.SUD defaults 0; verify writing PxCMD.SUD=1 triggers Phy initialization.
